title: New combinations of additives for LNMO batteries found with machine learning
summary: A model trained on data for 28 additives predicted the performance of 125 new combinations and identified formulations that outperformed the initial ones in tests. The study concerns high-voltage LNMO batteries; the Argonne announcement, accessed via Newswise, does not quantify the improvement or describe industrial-scale validation.
ai_technology: Machine learning on molecular features of additives

evidence.tested: Electrolyte additive combinations proposed by a model trained on 28 additives were tested in Gr||LNMO cells, and the ML-suggested mixtures outperformed the original set.
evidence.unknown: The source states the model used only 28 additives, gives no quantitative performance figures or top additive names, and does not describe industrial-scale validation.
evidence.ai_role: A machine learning model linked additive descriptors to battery performance and predicted the performance of 125 new combinations.
